purpose: Local patch bank built from available YOLO datasets, module-class datasets, predictions, and PV thermal dataset zips.
limitations: Best 8-class YOLO source is local-only because its data.yaml says license: Private.
Public Roboflow CC BY 4.0 sources are added for citable hotspot/diode/thermal-defect examples.
Infrared module classification crops are module-level classes, not object-detection boxes.
Old prediction crops are retained only as starter fallback and may contain annotation artifacts.
Panel texture crops are panel/module detections, not fault labels.
